wincon: You win if every character who has seen your character card is dead at the end of the game.
ability_text:
You must secretly reveal your character to anyone who gives you a Green card.

name: Coffee Machine
wincon: You win if you are alive at the end of the game with three or more Vendables and/or Equipment cards.
ability_text: You may draw Black or White cards as Vendables. These are kept face-down and separate from your Equipment cards. When an attack succeeds against you, the attacker may choose a Vendable; you may give them the Vendable to avoid the attack.
design_notes: We're questioning whether Vendables should be kept face-up or face-down. I think it'll be a nerf to Coffee Machine if they're kept face-up, and that'll entice other players to go after the cards.
